series_sources.series_rule: Numbered Final Fantasy titles retain distinct FFI through FFXVI series. Direct sequels/spinoffs such as FFX-2 and Advent Children group with their numbered subseries, with the exact source title preserved in game_title. FFBE, FFT, FF Type-0, WOTV FFBE, FFRK and World of Final Fantasy remain distinct. Kingdom Hearts III and Dark Road group under Kingdom Hearts; other collaborations use their source franchise.
